title: Analytics follows source observations with explicit time windows and error Retry
description: Use the isolated gateway and a pre-client terminal run. Drive actual source deletion, visible window input and a real recoverable source-read error. No provider or worker execution; no client-state injection.

proofTargets.claim: Actual terminal run deletion appends analytics and updates the mounted panel without Refresh.
Update time window advances the current relative lower bound while preserving project filters.
An actual source read error exposes Retry, which recovers the same selected query after source recovery.
